_comment: Intended differences between the DWC 3.7 and 3.6 sources of the Vue plugins, read by tools/lines-diff.js. Each entry lists what exists only on one side (only37 = vue/<Id>/dwc-src and vue/_shared, only36 = vue/<Id>/dwc36 and vue/_shared36); a trailing * is a prefix. The key * applies to every plugin. An entry of a plugin that matches nothing any more fails tests/lines-divergence.test.js (the lines converged: delete it). Anything not listed here is drift and fails the test. Porting the 3.7 fixes to 3.6 is an owner decision (docs/DWC-LINES.md, section Out of sync today).

manifest.reason: each line zip names its own DWC line; the universal zip sets dwcVersion 3

i18n.en.reason: 3.7 fix-vue/QA changes that change behavior and markup of the Activity page (event kinds camera, maintenance, note, box_black, meter_alarm, health_disk with their readable fallback; description_en for non-Spanish locales; History columns hidden on narrow screens; filter hint text): not a text-only fix, so they are left for the owner to port with a visual check on a real DWC 3.6 (fix-vue-report.md section 4)

i18n.es.reason: 3.7 fix-vue/QA changes that change behavior and markup of the Activity page (event kinds camera, maintenance, note, box_black, meter_alarm, health_disk with their readable fallback; description_en for non-Spanish locales; History columns hidden on narrow screens; filter hint text): not a text-only fix, so they are left for the owner to port with a visual check on a real DWC 3.6 (fix-vue-report.md section 4)

i18n.en.reason: texts of FileEditDialog (shared.edit_dialog_*): that dialog is a 3.7 piece used only by the stopped WorkshopConfig, so the Vue 2 shared pieces do not need it

i18n.es.reason: texts of FileEditDialog (shared.edit_dialog_*): that dialog is a 3.7 piece used only by the stopped WorkshopConfig, so the Vue 2 shared pieces do not need it

files.reason: dwc-host.js is the DWC 3.7 adapter (the 3.6 pieces import DWC internals directly); use-role.js and expand-transition.js are Vue 3 composables and transitions, 3.6 uses role-mixin.js; FileEditDialog.vue is used only by the stopped WorkshopConfig; zoom-plugin.js exists only on the 3.6 line: the zoom plugin of the charts is taken by the charts of the plugins only, not registered for every chart (commit 6a75f049); HelpTip.vue is the Vue 2 help button of the 3.6 line (DESIGN.md 7b), the 3.7 line is paused

i18n.en.reason: the checks of a motion procedure that the machine answers by itself (axes homed, probe ready and at rest: lib/precheck.js + RunStart.vue) were written on the DWC 3.6 line, the one in use; the 3.7 line still asks the person to tick them. Porting them to 3.7 needs a check on a real DWC 3.7

i18n.es.reason: the checks of a motion procedure that the machine answers by itself (axes homed, probe ready and at rest: lib/precheck.js + RunStart.vue) were written on the DWC 3.6 line, the one in use; the 3.7 line still asks the person to tick them. Porting them to 3.7 needs a check on a real DWC 3.7
